arc-hydration-urine: Your urine color is the simplest hydration test you have HYDRATION The simplest hydration test Your urine color is the simplest hydration test you have. Drinking too much water turns off vasopressin, and the kidneys clear the excess. off The kidneys can excrete up to about 1 liter of water an hour.
